Summary: A collection of educational mini-projects and exercises demonstrating graph-based workflow orchestration and agent patterns using LangGraph and LangChain. The repository implements directed acyclic graphs, conditional routing, cyclic execution loops, and Google GenAI LLM integrations.
Actions: Defined structured TypedDict state models across nodes to enforce type safety and state boundaries in HelloWorldGraph/main.py, Exercise1/main.py, and ConditionalGraph/main.py.
Engineered sequential multi-node processing pipelines that accumulate and transform structured data across graph transitions in Exercise3/main.py and MultiNodeGraph/main.py.
Implemented dynamic branching using conditional graph edges to inspect incoming operator states and dispatch execution to corresponding mathematical nodes in ConditionalGraph/main.py.
Constructed cyclical workflow loops using conditional edge predicates to iterate node execution until reaching numeric threshold limits in LoopGraph/main.py.
Integrated Google Gemini models into LangGraph conversational agents to handle multi-turn user dialog in SimpleBot/main.py and Chatbot/main.py.
Implemented local file persistence mechanisms to log and restore multi-turn conversation histories across user sessions in Chatbot/main.py.
Configured tool-calling agent scaffolding using LangGraph prebuilt ToolNode, custom tool definitions, and message reducer annotations in ReAct_Agent/main.py.
